name: matt
description: Tracks a task through Matt Pocock's idea-to-ship flow and shows the next step above the prompt.

autoAdvance.title: Auto-advance after approval
autoAdvance.description: After /matt approve, and when the model reports a build or closing stage finished (implement, implement-spec, diagnosing-bugs, pr), run the next stage at once instead of showing it. Planning never starts a build, gates still wait for you, and a full context stops it.

clearAt.title: Context nudge (%)
clearAt.description: From this share of the context window, the band and each gate suggest /clear before the next stage.
